summary.text: Jonathan Fritz is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2016, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 111, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Fritz assumed office on December 1, 2016.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Finance (subcommittee chair on Tax Modernization and Reform), Gaming Oversight (vice chair), Insurance, and Rules.
